source: FJC Integrated Database, Bankruptcy Petition NewSTATS Snapshots (BPNS), FY2008-present
fileFormat: Tab-delimited text with a header row of 87 SAS short names. Text zips: textfiles/cpbank08to17.zip, textfiles/cpbank18on.zip (one row per case per fiscal-year snapshot). datasets/*.zip are SAS .sas7bdat per year.
valueNote: Codebook lists y/n codes in lowercase; the FY2025 text file carries PRFILE as uppercase Y/N and D1FPRSE/JOINT as lowercase y/n. Compare case-insensitively (upper(col)).
note: Variable names and definitions verified against the Feb 2023 codebook. status 'confirmed' = the codebook cites the form, line or petition field; 'inferred' = matched by meaning (e.g. pro se = absence of an attorney).

SNAPSHOT.meaning: Snapshot ending date: Sept 30 for fiscal-year snapshots; the Sep 2026 release adds a rolling 06/30/2026 snapshot
SNAPSHOT.notOnPetition: FJC statistical bookkeeping, not a petition field.

SNAPFILE.meaning: 1 if filed during the snapshot period
SNAPFILE.notOnPetition: FJC statistical bookkeeping, not a petition field.

SNAPPEND.meaning: 1 if pending at end of snapshot period
SNAPPEND.notOnPetition: FJC statistical bookkeeping, not a petition field.

SNAPCLOS.meaning: 1 if closed during the snapshot period
SNAPCLOS.notOnPetition: FJC statistical bookkeeping, not a petition field.

CASEKEY.meaning: BK + circuit + district + office + docket + generation + sequence

DISTRICT.lookup: table fjc_district (code, name) from codebook Appendix A; spokes/fjc/districts.json

OFFICE.mappingNote: CourtDivisionalOfficeCode is declared in the schema but no Official Form field in this IEPD uses it; the office is assigned by the court.

FILEDATE.notOnPetition: Assigned by the court when the petition is docketed. The petition carries only the debtor's signature date.

FILEFY.notOnPetition: Derived by the FJC from FILEDATE (federal fiscal year, Oct-Sep).

ORGFLSUBCHP.meaning: Chapter 11 subchapter V small business reorganization case, as represented on the first record submitted (codebook p.34): V = Subchapter V, blank = missing. Valid as of the 12/31/2022 snapshot.

CRNTCHP.meaning: Chapter on current record at end of snapshot; differs from ORGFLCHP after conversion
CRNTCHP.notOnPetition: Recorded on the court docket after filing; the petition cannot contain it. The petition chapter is ORGFLCHP; CRNTCHP differs after a conversion.

ORGNTRDBT.meaning: Nature of debt as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.36): b=Business c=Consumer o=Other; blank for Ch.15

NTRDBT.meaning: b=Business c=Consumer o=Other; blank for Ch.15 (most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; ORGNTRDBT is the as-filed value, and the two differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings)

D1CNTY.meaning: Debtor 1 county, 5-digit FIPS; 88888 outside home state, 99999 outside U.S.

ORGD1FPRSE.meaning: Debtor 1 pro se flag as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.39): y = pro se, n = represented
ORGD1FPRSE.mappingNote: pro se = absence of j:Attorney on B101

D1FPRSE.meaning: y = debtor 1 pro se (no attorney) on most recent filing record; n = represented (most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; ORGD1FPRSE is the as-filed value, and the two differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings)
D1FPRSE.mappingNote: pro se = absence of j:Attorney on B101; see also PayPetitionPreparerIndicator

D2ZIP.meaning: Debtor 2 ZIP (codebook p.40): ZIP or ZIP+4 of the second-listed debtor's street address

ORGFEESTS.meaning: Filing fee status as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.43): c=installments completed i=paying installments n=missing p=paid in full at filing u=not paid w=IFP waived; blank = unknown
ORGFEESTS.caution: FJC code c (installments completed) has no hub equivalent; the hub list is i, p, u, w.

FEESTS.meaning: Filing fee status on the most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; 'may be updated over the life of the case' (codebook p.43): c=installments completed i=paying installments n=missing p=paid in full at filing u=not paid w=IFP waived; blank = unknown
FEESTS.notOnPetition: Current-record status, not the petition's answer. It differs from ORGFEESTS (as filed) in 48.0% of FY2025 filings and is blank for 173,709 cases that ORGFEESTS records as paid in full. Use ORGFEESTS.

ORGDBTRTYP.meaning: Debtor type as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.43-44): i=Individual p=Partnership u=Corporation/LLC/LLP n=Other

DBTRTYP.meaning: i=Individual p=Partnership u=Corporation/LLC/LLP n=Other (same codes as the hub) (most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; ORGDBTRTYP is the as-filed value, and the two differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings)

NOB.codes: s Stockbroker, c Commodity Broker, b Clearing Bank, x Railroad, r Single Asset Real Estate, h Health Care Business, n Non-profit Organization, o Other, blank = consumer debt
NOB.caution: The codebook (p.46) says n = Non-profit Organization, o = Other, blank = Consumer Debt, but FY2025 data does not follow it: 62,104 cases carry n, 40,713 of them consumer cases and 61,881 with TAXEXEMPT = N, and no case carries o. In practice n behaves like the petition's 'None of the above' (hub code O). Use TAXEXEMPT for non-profit status. The hub codes also differ (o = Tax Exempt Entity, O = None of the above), so never compare case-insensitively. Before CM/ECF 4.1 (Jan 2011) a trailing t marked tax-exempt (e.g. ht).

TAXEXEMPT.meaning: Whether a business is a tax-exempt (non-profit) organization (codebook p.72): n = No, y = Yes. Collected since CM/ECF 4.1 (January 2011); previously carried in NATURE OF BUSINESS.
TAXEXEMPT.caution: FY2025 values are uppercase Y/N; compare with lower(). No Official Form field in this IEPD uses BusinessTaxExemptIndicator (tax-exempt status is asked on the non-individual petition, B201).

PRFILE.meaning: y/n prior bankruptcy in previous 8 years, as reported on the petition

ORGEASST.meaning: Estimated assets range code as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.47)

EASST.meaning: Estimated assets range code (letters A-M; FY2025 also has 52 cases with undocumented digit codes 1-8) (most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; ORGEASST is the as-filed value, and the two differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings)

ORGELBLTS.meaning: Estimated liabilities range code as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.51)

ELBLTS.meaning: Estimated liabilities range code (most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; ORGELBLTS is the as-filed value, and the two differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings)

ORGECRDTRS.meaning: Estimated creditors range code as reported on the first record submitted to the AOUSC (codebook p.54)

ECRDTRS.meaning: Estimated creditors range code A-J (most current record as of the end of the snapshot period; ORGECRDTRS is the as-filed value, and the two differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings)

SMLLBUS.meaning: Whether a Chapter 11 debtor is a small business debtor under 11 U.S.C. 101(51D), as indicated on the petition
SMLLBUS.codes: y Yes, n No, blank missing; valid for Chapter 11 only

TOTASSTS.meaning: Real + personal property from Summary of Schedules

TOTLBLTS.meaning: Secured + priority + nonpriority, nulls as zero

NDSCHRGD.meaning: Sum of the six 'certain liabilities' lines (28 U.S.C. 159(c))

DSCHRGD.notOnPetition: Derived by the FJC from Summary of Schedules totals; no single petition field.

TOTDBT.meaning: Derived: DSCHRGD + NDSCHRGD; may differ from TOTLBLTS on null handling
TOTDBT.notOnPetition: Derived by the FJC (DSCHRGD + NDSCHRGD). Unlike TOTLBLTS, blank schedules stay missing instead of becoming $0.

AVGMNTHI.meaning: Schedule I line 12 combined monthly income

CLOSEDT.notOnPetition: Recorded on the court docket after filing; the petition cannot contain it.

CLCHPT.notOnPetition: Recorded on the court docket after filing; the petition cannot contain it.

D1FDSP.meaning: Debtor 1 final disposition: A standard discharge, B hardship discharge, D n/a, E denied, F waived, G revoked, H-K dismissed (fee, info, abuse, other), L/M transfers
D1FDSP.notOnPetition: Recorded on the court docket after filing; the petition cannot contain it. Case outcome (discharge, dismissal, transfer).

D1CPRSE.notOnPetition: Recorded on the court docket after filing; the petition cannot contain it. D1FPRSE is the petition-time flag.

notCaptured: names, SSNs, addresses (only ZIP and county FIPS are published)
caveats: One record per case per snapshot, and snapshots overlap: the Sep 2026 release's rolling 06/30/2026 snapshot repeats 145,740 FY2025 cases from the 09/30/2025 year-end snapshot. The loaders dedupe on CASEKEY, keeping the latest SNAPSHOT (557,540 FY2025 new filings, not 703,280).
Schedule totals are required only for individual debtors with primarily consumer debt and are debtor-reported, not validated.
Debtor-level fields (ZIP, county, pro se) were corrected in Nov 2021 for FY2008-Jun 2021; re-download anything older.
TOTLBLTS treats nulls as zero; TOTDBT treats them as missing, so the two differ.
y/n flags are not consistently cased: in FY2025 PRFILE is Y/N while JOINT and D1FPRSE are y/n. Compare with lower().

The bundled data/sample file is the first 20,000 FY2025 new-filing rows of cpbank18on.txt, not a random sample. Numbers from it are illustrative; load a full year before citing anything. Check count(*) on fjc_bk to see which is loaded.
DISTRICT is an FJC code (73 = California - Central, 3A = Florida - Middle); join table fjc_district for names (codebook Appendix A).

NOB: the FY2025 data does not follow the codebook's NOB labels. 62,104 cases carry n (codebook: Non-profit), 40,713 of them consumer cases, so n behaves like 'None of the above'. Use TAXEXEMPT for non-profit status. Never compare NOB case-insensitively against the hub (hub o = Tax Exempt Entity, O = None of the above).

ORG* variables are the status on the first record submitted (as filed); the unprefixed versions are the most current record. The petition corresponds to ORG*. They differ in under 1% of FY2025 filings except fee status: FEESTS differs from ORGFEESTS in 48.0%.

The FJC data covers every bankruptcy case; this IEPD covers only the individual petition (B101/B105). In FY2025, 12,841 cases are non-individual debtors (DBTRTYP u, p or n; Form B201) and 203 are chapter 9 or 15. For petition-level questions filter dbtrtyp = 'i'.
